title: Spice pays Credits when played or discarded
notes: Issue #4410: S #89 Spice pays its quote as a Resource does when played or discarded, the hand sale gone (R4410000); the AI prices it as any (1) card (R4410001). The view's Marketplace keeps its sales, always empty, so a game with no Spice in it reads as before. The plays are the cards classify finds playing differently through Spice: S #173 Abandoned Spice Tower, which adds Spice, and C+ #65, C+ #67, S+ #18 and the Drone Interceptor token in the games a Spice changes. No script kept: replays that played, discarded or sold Spice are refused by their hash (R767000).

player.title: Spice gives Credits when played
changes: Spice no longer sells from your hand at the Marketplace: it gives you Credits like a Resource when you play it or discard it, 4–13 (Radiant 8–25).
While the Marketplace is open, Spice in your hand shows in braces how many Credits it gives.
The Marketplace no longer has a Sell section.
